eventDetail.scope: ICEC aims to empower society for sustainable development by applying various emerging computing technologies. The purpose of this conference is to aggregate professionals, researchers, educationalists, social activists, industry experts, and policymakers in broad domains of emerging computing like business, economics, entrepreneurship, education, tourism, hospitality, agriculture, health care, and other related areas including core sciences and engineering. The objective is to share opinions, identify challenges, offer best practices, and provide result driven computational based feasible solutions to facilitate the growth and prosperity of society as a whole.
